conn.denied: Login rejected – check the access code
total.label: Total print time
total.hint: Counted while BambuBar is running; the printer doesn't report its lifetime hours.
hint.keys: r refresh · s settings · esc close
form.title: Printer
form.intro: The printer must be in LAN mode. IP address, serial number and access code are on the printer's screen under Settings → WLAN / Device.
form.codeKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved code
form.keyring: The access code is kept in your keyring.
error.invalid-host: That isn't a valid IP address or host name.
error.invalid-serial: The serial number can only contain letters and digits.
error.invalid-code: The access code can't contain spaces.
error.demo: Settings can't be changed in demo mode.
error.bridge: The BambuBar helper isn't running. Try again in a moment.
warning.keyring: Saved, but the access code couldn't go into the keyring, so you'll have to enter it again after a restart.
warning.config: Connected, but the settings file couldn't be written, so you'll have to enter them again after a restart.
ams.name: AMS %1
trust.changed: The printer at %1 shows a different certificate than the one saved. That happens after a factory reset, or when another device has taken the printer's address. The access code was not sent.
trust.wrong: The device at %1 identifies itself as %2, not %3. Check the IP address in the settings. The access code was not sent.
